description:
## Goal

After fz-kdt.4 replaces RuntimeDemand cone replay, prove the final epic head restores or improves the range-map deterministic compiler-work budget. A generous wall-clock nontermination guard may land independently through fz-kdt.175; it is not performance evidence and does not waive this ticket.

## Recorded transition signal

Under one GitHub llvm-cov job, the range-map run interval was approximately 1.47s on main, 3.02s after fz-kdt.47, 2.95s after fz-tfn.3, 3.02s after fz-kdt.72, 3.02s after fz-tfn.17, and 2.25s after fz-kdt.45. Wall clock identified the regression but is contention-sensitive.

Deterministic range-map evidence is authoritative:

- main: 918 scheduler jobs, 3,837 product settlements, 0 CallableResolution jobs, and cone work 13 settlements / 623 member visits / 151 rounds / 2,971 derivations;
- recorded direct-fact transition: 1,083 scheduler jobs, 3,798 product settlements, 84 CallableResolution jobs, and cone work 18 / 898 / 216 / 4,276;
- the transition preserved the then-current backend/native inventory: 59 executables, 193 bodies, and 95,220 code bytes.

The historical temporary callable-resolution barrier plus retained cone repartition/replay explained the extra work. fz-kdt.4 has deleted that cone model. Approved subsequent removal of proven-unused helpers changes those historical native inventories; they are not mandatory current counts.

## Strategy and TDD

1. Land only after fz-kdt.4 removes whole-cone settlement/retry/publication.
2. Count per-executable RuntimeDemand formula evaluations and exact causing movements for range-map, 00420, and predicate fixtures.
3. Add deterministic work ratchets against the recorded pre-cutover baselines; pin the post-cutover counts only after proving strict improvement.
4. Require zero cone/replay symbols and telemetry, zero readiness-caused RuntimeDemand evaluations, and zero unattributed evaluations.
5. Prove live backend/native executable and body contracts, required canonical artifacts, diagnostics and stdout parity. Apply the user's approved removal rule: cross-version inventory/byte differences are allowed only for proven-unused removal or causally demonstrated less work, with every difference attributed. Same-version unchanged artifacts and reuse remain exact.
6. Record a release-mode distribution only as corroborating evidence, never as a test threshold.
7. Remove temporary comparison counters, switches, captures, and migration fixtures before review. Reuse retained causal/corpus observations rather than adding duplicate compilation loops.
8. Run all target doors, full library, serial matrix, fz2_cli, cross-process determinism, formatting, and strict clippy.

## Acceptance

- RuntimeDemand deterministic work is strictly better than the recorded mainline cone derivation baselines for range-map, 00420, and predicate fixtures.
- No cone collection, round, retry, snapshot replay, whole-cone publication, or associated telemetry remains.
- Readiness movement causes no RuntimeDemand formula evaluation and every non-initial evaluation names changed content.
- Semantic product answers, live backend/native contracts, required artifacts, diagnostics and runtime outputs retain full fidelity. Same-version unchanged artifacts/reuse are exact. Approved cross-version removals of proven-unused work are explicitly attributed, not restored merely to match obsolete counts.
- The fixture timeout is documented only as a nontermination guard; no wall-clock performance threshold is introduced.
- The epic cannot complete while this ticket is open.

## Implementation and proof

Unblocked by .29 (closed in 4fc5616d8), with compiler predecessor .27 (534570e5a). The candidate removes the premature continue between discovering construction targets and loading their available inputs: both enter one snapshot update before another body walk. Actual derive_executable_runtime_demand calls are counted in the existing JobEffects / JobCompletion / public causal report. Prerequisite-only returns count zero. Work counts are explicitly excluded from formula identity, with a synthetic regression proving changed counts cannot invent initial work or input evidence. The misleading scheduler-completion versus old-cone-derivation comparison is removed. No new telemetry stream or comparison mode exists.

RED: restored old continue fails the exact predicate cold walk ratchet, 632 versus 592, /tmp/fz-tfn24-red-coherent-input.log, handle 70321 exit 101. The initial attempt to require a range-local improvement was rejected: range does not hit the redundant target/input phase and correctly stays flat. Final augmented-source five-request pins (cold, unchanged, irrelevant, reached leaf, replaced callee) are range [246,0,0,9,179], predicate [592,0,0,58,394], take/drop [1283,0,0,63,758]. Before change predicate was [632,0,0,75,463], take/drop [1451,0,0,83,878]. Scheduler completions, changed outputs and wakes remain unchanged. All non-initial demand jobs remain content-caused, with zero readiness or unexplained work.

Mainline comparisons use original fixtures, full command traces including macros, and matching command doors. Range run 2971 -> 243; predicate interp 6378 -> 589; 00420 interp 6252 -> 1280. The existing six-process CLI observation bundle pins interpreter body walks and exact repeated causal/backend artifacts. Its existing all-door test additionally reads range native telemetry for the native baseline; no compiler invocation was added. Exact main a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83 predicate evidence is in fz-f98.23 and /tmp/fz-f98.23-enum-predicate.71630.jsonl (SHA256 ee72eea45123a5d2aa884e397a526c1e7a782917c96b925f1ede4743d6aec072). Take raw /tmp/fz-kdt5-cold-00420-a3a9761d.jsonl (SHA256 50fdfeb20ccd7e97981f46dd6158a8f9c73953a99a8a49fcd82714f7f8eb001d) sums [2,2,1028,1028,1028,1028,1068,1068] to 6252; earlier 6250 was arithmetic error. Historical range interp2401 lacks proven exact-main provenance and is not the acceptance baseline.

Independent root verification uses immutable /tmp/fz-tfn24-after.n6luYj/fz2 (SHA256 49fedc62aa0778487ee68de320599c550b39dab186c456198b6096b8ba5c8b77). All six original-fixture interp/native runs exit0 with golden stdout; all three backend and CLIF dumps are byte-identical to .27 baseline /tmp/fz-tfn27-after.2d8YSN. All per-family product evaluated/settled counts and scheduler jobs1393/2394/4233 remain exact. Native codegen counts144/472/1036 and bytes31004/101744/302304 remain exact. Approved .27 unused-helper removals are preserved. Source search finds no demand-cone implementation or telemetry. Full evidence is in .agent/measurements/fz-tfn.24-runtime-demand-work.md; agent performance docs explain actual walks versus completions and retain timeout as nontermination guard only.

## Verification boundary

Full library GREEN1896 passed +6 existing ignored (/tmp/fz-tfn24-lib.log, handle53692 exit0). CLI GREEN30 (/tmp/fz-tfn24-cli.log, handle99947 exit0); final repeat after observation-error formatting cleanup is live20260 at /tmp/fz-tfn24-cli-final.log. Strict workspace/all-target/all-feature clippy finalGREEN (/tmp/fz-tfn24-clippy-final.log). Docs GREEN with1 existing ignored (/tmp/fz-tfn24-doc.log, handle96568 exit0). Formatting/diff-check green. Serial matrix is live55878 at /tmp/fz-tfn24-matrix.log. Release build GREEN (37614 exit0); copied release binary SHA256 61e5f32ccfb1d1a6b9aa670de51cfd104065a9319ee82ff5b7b68d8495530d08 awaits corroborative distribution after local gates finish. Fresh scoped cold review and commit/close remain root-owned. No acceptance is claimed until these remaining gates finish.
title: Restore range-map work budget after RuntimeDemand cutover
